Job description:- 
 Java 8 Developer
 Requires experience with Java 8, including lambdas and streaming logic. Experience with XML and JSON desired. 
 Will be responsible for implementing our federated API accessing our organization data and allowing for CRUD functionality. 
 Must have experience with agile processes. 
 Will be working on a team geographically located in Rochester, NY and Bangalore, India so communication skills will be needed. 

 Graduate 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
